name: contract-panel-visual
description: Visual verification of the contract panel UI: available contracts list with material type, quantity, unit price, deadline and penalties; active contracts with progress; completed contract history; accept/reject/negotiate buttons. Accept, the delivery amount and Deliver are all driven through the Contracts panel's own controls (issue #479); only the clock, world setup and the read-only list/status steps remain console commands The Contracts panel is opened once and left open: the tool rail TOGGLES a panel, so re-clicking its entry would close the panel the next step needs.

steps.description: event choose 0 — follows a bare tick, so whether an event is pending is a random roll and there may be no dialog on screen at all. Deliberately left unconverted: a player step must name a control that is actually there, and forcing a click here would fail on the roll rather than on a defect.

BLOCKED FINDING, left unconverted deliberately: this scenario never mines or hauls any ore, so nothing is in storage and the Contracts panel correctly disables Deliver (maxDeliverable <= 0). The console rejects it too — consumeStoredOre fails — but it returns success:false rather than throwing, and the command-mode runner only fails a step on a thrown exception, so command mode reports this no-op as a pass (the #445 class). Converting it to a click is what surfaced that; papering over it with a command would hide it again.
